title: Mixed Duo #31
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, extraordinarily large women, far beyond any real person, a mix of pregnant and non-pregnant figures.

#1: Brazilian, in her late 30s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, braided hair, real pores, real living eyes, 100 drop dangles piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in copper-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of rose-gold a bracelet. Painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern, a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide cream bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands on her own hips, elbows held wide, confident direct gaze, extreme cream extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Italian, in her late 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and dominating her entire middle, an enormous taut, high, rounded pregnant belly, far larger and more prominent than any ordinary pregnancy, projecting forward dramatically, the navel pushed outward on its smooth rounded surface. Enormous round hips below it, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, thick glossy dark-brown hair set in a high backcombed style, a smouldering, confident expression, low bun hair, real pores, real living eyes, 15 drop dangles piercings set with sapphires in gold-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of silver earrings. Painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern, a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide silver bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, the densest concentration wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, extreme silver extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
